# Zib Digital inline logo pack

Use this file only when you cannot load images from web links and the person has not attached the logo files. Each logo is a small PNG with a transparent background, embedded as a data URI. In HTML output, paste the data URI straight into the `src` of an `<img>` tag. Do not edit, recolour or redraw the logo. For print or large sizes, ask for the full-size files from https://github.com/zibdigitalnz/zib-brand-assets (`logos/zib/`).

Black versions go on light backgrounds. White versions go on dark backgrounds.

## zib-wordmark-black
Primary wordmark, for light backgrounds (600 x 125 px).

`<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Primary wordmark" width="300">`

## zib-wordmark-white
Primary wordmark, for dark backgrounds (600 x 125 px).

`<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Primary wordmark" width="300">`

## zib-monogram-black
Monogram zd., for light backgrounds (240 x 137 px).

`<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Monogram zd." width="120">`

## zib-monogram-white
Monogram zd., for dark backgrounds (240 x 137 px).

`<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Monogram zd." width="120">`
